page.overview:
What is Shimotsuki Village?

Shimotsuki Village is a village in East Blue and Roronoa Zoro's homeland. It was founded by pirates, around 52 years ago.

The village was named after Shimotsuki Kouzaburou, a member of the Shimotsuki Family from Wano Country and one of the village's aforementioned founders.

The is a kenjutsu school, a school of Japanese swordsmanship. Its owner is Koushirou, who is a skilled swordsman and father of the deceased Kuina. It is the place where Zoro developed and trained in his Three Sword Style and, in the anime, it is the only dojo whose sign Zoro did not take down.

It is revealed that 12 years before the current storyline, the town was visited by Monkey D. Dragon and his revolutionaries, and that the dojo assisted them by providing supplies for the injured residents of the Gray Terminal.
